name: zturret_on_damage
description: zTurret_Runtime::OnDamage is the OptCatalog hit callback that forwards turret damage and updates HUD/damage-feedback state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a coherent zTurret class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x437d60 validates the fastcall callback ABI, forwarding damageAmount, OptCatalogEntryDef, and hitEvent to ApplyDamageAndHandleDestruction, setting damage context kind 1 and awarding healthMax through Player::AddScaledHudCounterValue on destruction, and otherwise updating DamageFeedback intensity from healthCurrent / healthMax.
The native smoke verifies the non-destruction feedback scalar path and destruction path side effects on damage context and HUD counter value.
